SELECT CAST(rc.room_category_id AS CHAR) AS roomCategoryId, CAST(rc.room_category_id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(rc.camp_id AS CHAR) AS campId, CAST(rc.poi_id AS CHAR) AS poiId, p.poi_name AS poiName, CAST(rc.group_id AS CHAR) AS roomCategoryGroupId, g.group_name AS roomCategoryGroupName, rc.name AS roomCategoryName, COALESCE(rc.display_name, rc.name) AS name, COALESCE(rc.room_count, 0) AS roomNum, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(r.room_name ORDER BY r.sort_no ASC, r.room_id ASC SEPARATOR ',') FROM room r WHERE r.room_category_id = rc.room_category_id AND r.status = 1 AND r.is_deleted = 0 ) AS roomNames, COALESCE(rc.room_count, 0) AS inventory, rc.guest_count AS checkinGuestCount, rc.weekday_price_cent AS basePrice, rc.weekend_price_cent AS weekendPrice, rc.holiday_price_cent AS holidayPrice, rc.earliest_check_in_hour AS earliestCheckInTime, rc.latest_check_in_hour AS latestCheckInTime, rc.latest_check_out_hour AS latestCheckOutTime, rc.display_name AS displayName, rc.highlight_description AS highlightDescription, rc.nearby_description AS nearbyDescription, rc.article_description AS articleDescription, ( SELECT CAST(m.media_resource_id AS CHAR) FROM room_category_media m WHERE m.room_category_id = rc.room_category_id AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.scene_type = 'cover' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.sort_no ASC, m.media_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS mainPhotoMediaId, ( SELECT COALESCE(m.media_url, mr.url) FROM room_category_media m LEFT JOIN media_resource mr ON mr.media_resource_id = m.media_resource_id AND mr.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m.room_category_id = rc.room_category_id AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.scene_type = 'cover' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.sort_no ASC, m.media_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS mainPhotoMediaUrl, ( SELECT COALESCE(m.media_url, mr.url) FROM room_category_media m LEFT JOIN media_resource mr ON mr.media_resource_id = m.media_resource_id AND mr.is_deleted = 0 WHERE m.room_category_id = rc.room_category_id AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.scene_type = 'cover' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.sort_no ASC, m.media_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS mainPhoto, p.address AS fullAddress FROM room_category rc LEFT JOIN pms_poi p ON p.poi_id = rc.poi_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 LEFT JOIN room_category_group g ON g.group_id = rc.group_id AND g.is_deleted = 0 AND g.status = 1
ORDER BY rc.sort_no ASC, rc.room_category_id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT rc.name AS roomName, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM room r WHERE r.camp_id = rc.camp_id AND r.room_category_id = rc.room_category_id AND r.status = 1 AND r.is_deleted = 0 ), COALESCE(rc.room_count, 0)) AS inventory, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_main om WHERE om.camp_id = rc.camp_id AND om.room_category_id = rc.room_category_id AND om.is_deleted = 0 AND om.order_type = 'daily_room' AND om.status = 'checked_in' ) AS staying, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_main om WHERE om.camp_id = rc.camp_id AND om.room_category_id = rc.room_category_id AND om.is_deleted = 0 AND om.order_type = 'daily_room' AND om.status IN ('booked', 'pending', 'refunding') ) AS pendingOrders FROM room_category rc WHERE rc.camp_id = #{campId} AND rc.room_category_id = #{roomCategoryId} AND rc.status = 1 AND rc.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(ca.channel_name, ''), CONCAT('渠道', ca.channel_id)) AS label, rc.weekday_price_cent AS basePrice, rc.weekend_price_cent AS weekendPrice, rel.shelf_status AS shelfStatus, rel.audit_status AS auditStatus FROM channel_room_category_rel rel JOIN channel_account ca ON ca.account_id = rel.account_id AND ca.camp_id = rel.camp_id JOIN room_category rc ON rc.room_category_id = rel.room_category_id AND rc.camp_id = rel.camp_id WHERE rel.camp_id = #{campId} AND rel.room_category_id = #{roomCategoryId} ORDER BY ca.account_id ASC
